description: This file defines a helper class for logging, acting as an abstraction over Android's native Log class. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error, assert) and manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log output.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods to log messages at various levels and manages a chain of LogNode objects for output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain where log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates the log message to the LogNode for output.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warn message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert-level message, with optional Throwable.
